title: A Prospective Observational Cohort Study of Antihypertensive Therapy Adherence
abstract: Background: Hypertension management requires rigorous adherence. Methods: Consecutive patients were recruited from outpatient hypertension clinics and followed for 12 months. Multivariable logistic regression was used to adjust for age, baseline blood pressure, and comorbidities. Laboratory-confirmed blood pressure records were extracted directly from verified electronic medical records. Results: High adherence was observed in 72% of patients.
fullText:
Methods:
Consecutive patients were recruited from outpatient hypertension clinics.
A representative cohort of 850 individuals was monitored.
Multivariable logistic regression was used to adjust for confounding.
Laboratory-confirmed blood pressure records were extracted directly from verified electronic medical records.
Blind assessment of primary outcomes was maintained throughout follow-up.
